bias.en: Rebound · back above the Jul 29 low, under every average
bias.zh: 反弹 · 重回 7月29日低点上方，仍在所有均线下方

read.en: TSMC rose 6.3% on Nov 6 to $375.44, trading between $367.95 and $380.72 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($385.5), 10-day ($406.6), 30-day ($432.6) and 100-day ($427.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($401.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($427.45), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 台积电 11月6日上涨 6.3%，收于 $375.44，盘中区间 $367.95–380.72，成交量明显放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$385.5）、10 日（$406.6）、30 日（$432.6）和 100 日均线（$427.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$401.5）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$427.45），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The bounce reclaimed the $372.7 Jul 29 low, support again, but stopped at the $380.7–382.2 zone (Nov 5–6 highs, Jul 28 low, Apr 14 high). Resistance is $380.7–382.2, then $385.5–388.8 (5-day, July lows) and $401.5 (200-day). Support is $372.7, then $359.2–368 (Nov 6 low, April lows) and $350.5–351.2 (Nov 5 low, Mar 25 high). A close above $382.2 would target $386–389; below $372.7, $360–368.
